title: Chat deletes only after the User says yes
shows: Asked to delete, the Agent only offers a confirmation. Cancel leaves the record; Yes, delete carries it out. The model never deletes by itself.
limits: Real model on a local stack; the model is not deterministic, so this is one recorded run.
